answer: Require every agent to post a reputation bond that only accrues through a time-stamped, cryptographically linked thread of completed work across epochs. A sybil that wanders in and spins up thousands of fresh identities cannot fake the history: each verified action must chain to earlier ones, the way a raven follows a continuous track along a branch. Since each identity must earn months of real service before it counts, mass-creating fakes becomes economically pointless while honest agents pass by default.
